newsitem.title: USA: Miami Computer stake held by group.
newsitem.headline: Miami Computer stake held by group.

text.p: A group including Fisher Ewing Partners and Value Partners Ltd said Thursday it held a stake in Miami Computer Supply Corp equivalent to 14.32 percent of the company's common stock outstanding.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said the two private investment firms bought 150,000 shares of Miami Computer on November 12 for $1.4 million. The shares represent a 4.42 percent stake in Miami Computer.
In addition, Value Partners and Timothy Ewing, one of two general partners of Fisher Ewing partners, hold 333,829 shares, representing 9.9 percent of the total outstanding.
The shares form part of the 1.6 million shares, or 47.6 percent of the outstanding, held by Pittsburgh Investment Group LLC, in which Value Partners and Ewing are members.
According to the filing, Value Partners owns an 18.9 percent stake and Ewing a 1.7 percent stake in Pittsburgh Investment.
The group holds its stake in Miami Computer for investment purposes.
Miami Computer, a Dayton, Ohio-based computer and office automation supplies distributor, made its initial public stock offering on November 12.
